blurb: Madison Boats offers rentals of kayaks, stand up paddle boards, fishing boats, and pontoon boats across four locations on three lakes. Guests can enjoy guided experiences such as the Legends on the Lake ghost story paddling tour and Full Moon Paddle events. The company also provides memberships, private boat storage, and group rental services.
